abstract: BACKGROUND: The records of 98 consecutive patients (58 males and 40 females; median age, 27 years; age range, 2-64 years) who presented with a primary germ cell tumor (GCT) of the mediastinum between January 1960 and December 1990 were reviewed. There were 45 mature teratomas, 8 immature teratomas, 16 pure seminomas, and 24 malignant nonseminomatous GCT (MNSGCT). RESULTS: All patients with mature teratomas were cured by radical resection alone, except one patient who died intraoperatively. Among the eight patients with immature teratomas, five were treated before the advent of cisplatin treatment (two children younger than 15 years were cured by surgery alone and three adults died within 7 months after operation). Three patients underwent surgery followed by cisplatin-based chemotherapy (two are still alive and one died of an associated rhabdomyosarcoma). Thirteen of 16 patients with seminomas (81%) were cured by surgery either alone (5 patients) or with adjuvant radiation therapy (8 patients). Among the 24 MNSGCT, 10 were treated before 1980 without cisplatin and all but 1 died of disease progression. Fourteen patients were treated by initial high-dose cisplatin combination chemotherapy and 8 (57%) achieved complete remission (2 died of systemic mastocytosis development). CONCLUSIONS: Results indicate the benignity of mature teratomas of the mediastinum, the age-dependent clinical course of immature teratomas, and the excellent prognosis of seminomas. The improved survival advantage resulting from cisplatin-based chemotherapy in MNSGCT is impaired by the propensity to nongerminal solid tumor development and hematologic malignancies.
abstract_ja:
背景：1960年1月から1990年12月の間に縦隔原発の胚細胞腫瘍（GCT）と診断された連続98例（男性58例、女性40例；年齢中央値27歳、年齢範囲2～64歳）の診療記録を後方視的に検討した。内訳は成熟奇形腫45例、未熟奇形腫8例、純粋セミノーマ16例、悪性非セミノーマ性GCT（MNSGCT）24例であった。
結果：成熟奇形腫の患者は、術中死亡の1例を除き全例が根治的切除のみで治癒した。未熟奇形腫の8例のうち5例はシスプラチン導入前に治療され、15歳未満の小児2例は手術単独で治癒したが、成人3例は手術後7か月以内に死亡した。3例は手術後にシスプラチン併用化学療法を受け、2例は生存中、1例は合併した横紋筋肉腫で死亡した。セミノーマの16例中13例（81%）は、手術単独（5例）または術後補助放射線療法（8例）により治癒した。MNSGCT 24例のうち10例は1980年以前にシスプラチンなしで治療され、1例を除き全例が病勢進行で死亡した。14例は初回から高用量シスプラチン併用化学療法を受け、8例（57%）が完全寛解に至った（うち2例は全身性肥満細胞症の発症により死亡）。
結論：縦隔成熟奇形腫の良性の経過、未熟奇形腫の年齢依存的な臨床経過、およびセミノーマの良好な予後が示された。シスプラチン併用化学療法によるMNSGCTの生存上の利点は、非胚細胞性の固形腫瘍や血液悪性腫瘍の発生しやすさによって損なわれている。
